builds.name: Full Tilt explosion ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from Full Tilt explosion within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Full Tilt explosion within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: E5 bonus explosion is(7%+0.03% perAP)*target maxHP magic. AP raises percent-health term and MR modifiers strengthen it. Deathcap multiplies AP; Zhonya adds105AP; Riftmaker adds bonusHP-to-AP and8% full-ramp damage. Void/Shadowflame penetrate MR and amplify eligible low-health hits. Nearby Abyssal makes target take12% more magic damage. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

testPlan: Finite benchmark: Benchmark game30min,level18,max target rank,no elixirs/dragons/unlisted allied buffs. Enemy3000maxHP,900currentHP,100armor,50MR,1500bonusHP before legal debuffs; record raw overkill separately. E ready, Q/one attack delivers; actual passive MR theft recorded. Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record Full Tilt explosion tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Verify raw helper/statFormula mappings and conditional multipliers before treating result as established.

Rune reasoning: Rell — Full Tilt explosion: E5 bonus explosion is(7%+0.03% perAP)*target maxHP magic. AP raises percent-health term and MR modifiers strengthen it. Bloodline replaces non-scoring haste: 85 HP feeds the equipped Riftmaker HP-to-AP conversion. Keep conditional native modifiers separate from rune proc damage. Arcane Comet: Comet is separate damage and can miss; target movement and range affect the comparison. Manaflow Band: Earned maximum mana/resource utility; only actual mana conversions can turn it into offensive stats. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Bloodline: Exactly 15 earned stacks grant 85 HP, which equipped Riftmaker converts into AP; native output gains only through its actual HP/AP coefficients, not life-steal healing. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time. Manaflow: log ten actually earned procs if using its 250 bonus mana; never invent full stacks or mana-to-AP conversion. Bloodline benchmark: exactly 15 legitimately earned Legend stacks before measurement, granting 85 max HP. Read actual HP/AP after equipped conversions; with fewer stacks credit no completion HP. No extra attacks are added to the scored action budget.

Rune comparison: Compare a real prepared Conqueror page versus the selected page without changing target defenses, HP, earned item stacks, rank or time. Additional rune preparation must be its own recorded trial. Compare First Strike or a damage keystone only in a separately reported total-hit result; proc damage is outside the named native packet.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.
Q/Break the Mold damage excluded; no invented maximum stolen stats. Raw statFormula=2/Stat identifiers remain source evidence until runtime mapping confirmed; no unspecified stats/stacks granted.
tradeoffs: Six final items explicitly replace late-game boots; slower access/escape, extreme cost and setup dependence. Raw-number candidate sacrifices practical positioning and does not prove a global maximum.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

These are reasoned choices and comparison candidates; not a complete numerical rune solver or in-game verification.

builds.name: Crash Down: maximum-health shield
builds.summary: Investigate high one fresh Crash Down shield output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one fresh Crash Down shield output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The shield helper is 20/40/60/80/100 + 11% own maximum HP. AP instead scales the separate dismount impact. The shield persists until remounting according to the source tooltip; increased armored-form resistances change survival but are not extra shield capacity.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 30%, target HP 100%, observation 3s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap observed healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Exactly 500 earned Heartsteel HP, owner 30%, mounted before one legal Crash Down. Record actual total maximum HP and initial shield capacity after dismounting, with no previous or allied shield. Score initial capacity within three seconds; this observation does not define shield lifetime.

testPlan: Finite benchmark: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Exactly 500 earned Heartsteel HP, owner 30%, mounted before one legal Crash Down. Record actual total maximum HP and initial shield capacity after dismounting, with no previous or allied shield. Score initial capacity within three seconds; this observation does not define shield lifetime.

Compare zero versus 500 earned Heartsteel HP, then Visage against a higher-HP slot. Test remounting and damage consumption separately. Use an AP slot as a negative core shield-scaling control; exclude attack/item proc damage. Compare Dawncore against the former Hullbreaker slot at the same earned Heartsteel HP and runes. Record the reduction in max/bonus HP, static 16% shield power, actual First Light contribution and initial native shield capacity. Keep damage reduction, item/rune proc shields and ally effects separate.

Rune reasoning: Rell — one fresh Crash Down shield: The native output scales with owner HP or missing HP rather than direct AP. Revitalize and finite biscuit health matter; damage keystones, Shield Bash and extra proc shields are not native capacity or recovery. Ability basis: The shield helper is 20/40/60/80/100 + 11% own maximum HP. AP instead scales the separate dismount impact. The shield persists until remounting according to the source tooltip; increased armored-form resistances change survival but are not extra shield capacit Grasp of the Undying: Only actually earned permanent HP may feed an HP coefficient; proc damage/healing is separate. Font of Life: Separate conditional recovery; it does not enlarge the named native heal, shield or attack packet. Conditioning: Minute-12 armor/MR; direct only for matching resistance scaling, otherwise survival utility. Revitalize: Native eligible heal/shield modifier; low-HP bonus follows the actual recipient, not automatically the caster. Biscuit Delivery: Three earned consumed/sold biscuits add finite 90 HP; their heal is a separate event. Cosmic Insight: Item/summoner cooldown utility, not direct native ability output.

Rune preparation: Record three actually consumed/sold biscuits (+90 permanent HP in this snapshot). Do not grant free Grasp HP: keep any already-authored procs fixed; extra earned Grasp stacks are a separate benchmark. Revitalize uses the actual recipient HP and healing stops at full health. Recipient is self. Revitalize bonus below 40% is conditional on that recipient at application; do not silently grant it at full HP. Aery/Guardian/Font heals or shields remain separate from the named ability.

Rune comparison: Compare Overgrowth against Revitalize in separate legal pages; they occupy the same Resolve row and cannot be combined. Use exactly 150 observed nearby unit deaths for the Overgrowth comparison, not unlimited stacks. Item comparison: the former Hullbreaker adds 500 item HP plus its actual Warmog conversion, while Dawncore adds 16% static shield power. Compare both legal inventories at the same recorded stacks; count First Light only from the observed regeneration stat and verify modifier order.

Stat shards: Offense haste provides cooldown utility; it does not increase this one native HP-based event. Flex and defense scaling health feed the recorded maximum/missing-health coefficient. Record actual final HP and cap effective recovery at missing HP.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive - Mounted Alacrity: Rell gains @spell.RellW_Dismount:MountedMoveSpeed@ Move Speed while mounted.

Active - {{Spell_RellW_Dismount_Name}}: Rell leaps off her mount, Knocking Up enemies and dealing @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountDamage@ magic damage. Rell gains @spell.RellW_Dismount:Shield@ Shield, which lasts until she remounts.

Rell then enters her armored form, gaining @spell.RellW_Dismount:ResistanceIncrease*100@% increased Armor and Magic Resist, @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountedASBoost*100@% Attack Speed and @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountedRangeBoost@ Attack Range. In this armored form, she can use {{Spell_RellW_MountUp_Name2}}.
